C074.name: Songea Municipal Council
C074.documented: heavy Msimu rain, floods on the Ruvuma tributaries, and strong winds

area.en: Songea Municipal: hillside town and river valleys
area.sw: Manispaa ya Songea: mji wa milimani na mabonde ya mito

risk.en: This area is a hilly town where heavy rain floods valley streets and cuts gullies through hillside settlements, and lightning is frequent.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani ambapo mvua kubwa hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni na kuchimba makorongo kwenye makazi ya milimani, na radi hupiga mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains clear, build away from gully edges and stream banks and fit lightning arresters on public buildings. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the hillside gullies, building on the stream banks, filling the drains with waste and sheltering under trees or in open ground when thunder starts. Know the higher street or school ground away from the valley that your household will move to when the streams rise, go there when heavy rain sets in on the hills, and get indoors, away from windows and metal, when thunder is heard. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi, kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo na vijito na kuweka vizuia radi kwenye majengo ya umma. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye makorongo ya mlimani, kujenga kwenye kingo za vijito, kujaza mitaro taka na kujikinga chini ya miti au uwanjani ngurumo zinapoanza. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule mbali na bonde ambao kaya yako itahamia vijito vinapojaa, nenda huko mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani, na ingia ndani, mbali na madirisha na vyuma, ngurumo zinaposikika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C077.name: Mbinga Town Council
C077.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Matengo highlands, and valley floods

area.sw: Mji wa Mbinga: nyanda za juu za kahawa

risk.en: This area is a highland coffee town on steep slopes where heavy rain causes landslides and erosion and hailstorms damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa kahawa wa nyanda za juu kwenye miteremko mikali ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko na mmomonyoko na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes and build away from steep cuts and gullies. What raises the risk: opening new coffee or maize fields on the steepest slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house and building below gully mouths. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open above the houses or water runs muddy during heavy rain; when hail is forecast, get children and animals under a solid roof early. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na makorongo. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba mapya ya kahawa au mahindi kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba na kujenga chini ya midomo ya makorongo. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka juu ya nyumba au maji yakitiririka ya matope wakati wa mvua kubwa; mvua ya mawe ikitabiriwa, waweke watoto na mifugo chini ya paa imara mapema. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C075.name: Madaba District Council
C075.documented: heavy rain, valley floods, and strong winds

area.sw: Madaba: mashamba ya miombo na misitu

risk.en: This area has miombo farmland and forest where dry-season fires spread fast and wildlife from nearby reserves raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya miombo na misitu ambapo moto wa kiangazi husambaa haraka na wanyamapori kutoka hifadhi jirani huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to burn early and under control, keep fire breaks and use community deterrents against wildlife. What raises the risk: burning late in the dry season on windy days, leaving fires unattended, opening fields right against the forest edge and walking alone through the bush at dusk. Know the cleared open ground away from the miombo that your village will move to if fire comes, and move when smoke is seen on the forest edge; report fire and dangerous animals to the village leaders at once. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mapema kwa udhibiti, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchoma mwishoni mwa kiangazi siku za upepo, kuacha moto bila uangalizi, kufungua mashamba moja kwa moja mpakani mwa msitu na kutembea peke yako porini jioni. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa mbali na miombo ambao kijiji chenu kitahamia moto ukija, na ondokeni moshi ukionekana mpakani mwa msitu; ripoti moto na wanyama hatari kwa viongozi wa kijiji mara moja. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C076.name: Mbinga District Council
C076.documented: heavy rain, landslides, and floods on the highland valleys

area.en: Mbinga DC: steep coffee slopes and Ruhuhu valley
area.sw: Mbinga DC: miteremko mikali ya kahawa na bonde la Ruhuhu

risk.en: This area has steep coffee slopes prone to landslides and the Ruhuhu valley and coal areas where rivers flood farms and roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali ya kahawa inayokumbwa na maporomoko na bonde la Ruhuhu na maeneo ya makaa ya mawe ambapo mito hufurika mashamba na barabara.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from river banks and know flood-prone crossings. What raises the risk: opening fields on the steepest coffee slopes, cutting into the slope behind a house, building on the Ruhuhu banks and crossing the flooded drifts on foot or by motorcycle. Agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope, and move there when cracks open or water runs muddy; in the valley, know the higher ground your household will move to when the Ruhuhu rises, and wait at the crossings rather than wade. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na kingo za mito na kujua vivuko vinavyofurika. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba kwenye miteremko mikali zaidi ya kahawa, kuchimba mteremko nyuma ya nyumba, kujenga kwenye kingo za Ruhuhu na kuvuka vivuko vilivyofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki. Kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko, na hamieni huko nyufa zikifunguka au maji yakitiririka ya matope; bondeni, fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kaya yako itahamia Ruhuhu inapojaa, na subirini vivukoni badala ya kuvuka kwa miguu. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C079.name: Namtumbo District Council
C079.documented: heavy rain, Ruvuma floods, and a sharp dry season

area.en: Namtumbo: Selous edge and uranium areas
area.sw: Namtumbo: pembezoni mwa Selous na maeneo ya urani

risk.en: This area borders the Nyerere (Selous) reserve, where elephants raid crops and dry-season fires spread, and rains cut remote roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na hifadhi ya Nyerere (Selous), ambapo tembo huvamia mazao na moto wa kiangazi husambaa, na mvua hukata barabara za mbali.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to use community deterrents, keep fire breaks and keep food and medicine reserves before the rains. What raises the risk: opening fields and settling right against the reserve boundary, burning grass on windy days, and letting village food and medicine stocks run out before the roads close. Know the cleared open ground your village will move to if fire comes, report elephants near the fields to the village leaders at once rather than confronting them, and restock before the rains because the road may be cut for weeks. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kuweka akiba ya chakula na dawa kabla ya mvua. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba na kukaa moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi, kuchoma nyasi siku za upepo, na kuacha akiba za chakula na dawa za kijiji ziishe kabla barabara hazijafungwa. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kijiji chenu kitahamia moto ukija, ripoti tembo karibu na mashamba kwa viongozi wa kijiji mara moja badala ya kuwakabili, na jazeni akiba kabla ya mvua kwa sababu barabara inaweza kufungwa kwa wiki. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C078.name: Nyasa District Council
C078.documented: Lake Nyasa floods and large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and earthquake

area.en: Nyasa: Lake Nyasa shore and Livingstone slopes
area.sw: Nyasa: ufukwe wa Ziwa Nyasa na miteremko ya Livingstone

risk.en: This area has Lake Nyasa shore villages exposed to sudden storms and strong winds, and steep slopes behind them where landslides and flash floods occur.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya ufukwe wa Ziwa Nyasa vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba za ghafla na upepo mkali, na miteremko mikali nyuma yake ambapo maporomoko na mafuriko ya ghafla hutokea.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore when winds rise and build away from steep cuts and stream mouths. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded boats when the wind is rising, building at the stream mouths or under the cut slopes, and clearing the trees above the villages. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds on the lake, and the firm ground away from the stream mouths that your household will move to when heavy rain sets in on the Livingstone slopes; go when the streams start to rise, not after. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni upepo unapovuma na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na midomo ya vijito. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa upepo unapopanda, kujenga kwenye midomo ya vijito au chini ya miteremko iliyochongwa, na kukata miti juu ya vijiji. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka ziwani, na eneo imara mbali na midomo ya vijito ambalo kaya yako itahamia mvua kubwa inapoanza kwenye miteremko ya Livingstone; ondokeni vijito vikianza kupanda, si baadaye. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C073.name: Songea District Council
C073.documented: heavy rain, floods on streams to the Ruvuma, and strong winds

area.en: Songea DC: farmland and the Ruvuma headwaters
area.sw: Songea DC: mashamba na vyanzo vya mto Ruvuma

risk.en: This area has maize and tobacco farmland where dry spells and hail damage crops, and river headwaters that flood crossings in heavy rain.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya mahindi na tumbaku ambapo vipindi vya ukavu na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao, na vyanzo vya mito vinavyofurika vivuko wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant early-maturing varieties, keep household food reserves and know flood-prone crossings. What raises the loss and to the danger: relying on maize alone, selling the whole harvest at once, and crossing the flooded drifts on foot or by motorcycle. Agree early, as a household and a village, where food will come from in a failed season, and in heavy rain wait at the crossings rather than wade; when hail is forecast, get children and animals under a solid roof early. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mbegu zinazokomaa mapema, kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya na kujua vivuko vinavyofurika. Kinachoongeza hasara na hatari: kutegemea mahindi pekee, kuuza mavuno yote kwa mara moja, na kuvuka vivuko vilivyofurika kwa miguu au pikipiki. Kubalianeni mapema, kama kaya na kijiji, chakula kitatoka wapi msimu ukikosekana, na wakati wa mvua kubwa subirini vivukoni badala ya kuvuka kwa miguu; mvua ya mawe ikitabiriwa, waweke watoto na mifugo chini ya paa imara mapema. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C072.name: Tunduru District Council
C072.documented: heavy rain, wet-season floods, dry-season wildfire, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Tunduru: Ruvuma border, miombo and gem mining
area.sw: Tunduru: mpaka wa Ruvuma, miombo na uchimbaji wa vito

risk.en: This area borders Mozambique on the Ruvuma river, with miombo where elephants raid crops, gemstone pits that collapse in the rains and remote villages cut off by floods.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na Msumbiji kando ya mto Ruvuma, lina miombo ambapo tembo huvamia mazao, mashimo ya vito yanayobomoka wakati wa mvua na vijiji vya mbali vinavyotengwa na mafuriko.

advice.en: For those living, farming and mining here, it helps to use community deterrents, fence or backfill pits and keep homes above the river flood line. What raises the risk: digging gem pits without timbering and working them while rain is falling, settling right on the Ruvuma bank, and walking alone through the miombo at dusk. Keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts, know the higher ground away from the Ruvuma that your village will move to when the river rises, and report elephants near the fields to the village leaders at once rather than confronting them. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo na kujenga juu ya mstari wa mafuriko ya mto. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo ya madini bila mihimili na kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kukaa moja kwa moja kwenye ukingo wa Ruvuma, na kutembea peke yako kwenye miombo jioni. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza, fahamu eneo la juu mbali na Ruvuma ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia mto unapojaa, na ripoti tembo karibu na mashamba kwa viongozi wa kijiji mara moja badala ya kuwakabili. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
